preconditions.description: The number of nodes N is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges M is between 1 and the maximum of 100,000 or the number of possible edges in a complete graph with N nodes inclusive.
The integer P is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A <= N and 1 <= B <= N for A, B in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two nodes A and B, where both A and B are between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of critical links is between 0 and M inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all((len(component1) < P or len(component2) < P) for component1, component2 in critical_link_splits)
postconditions.description: For each critical link, the difference between the number of nodes on each side of the edge is less than P.
